map.♠/♥ 高阶花色 30 分/墩，♦/♣ 低阶花色 20 分/墩，无将首墩 40: Spades/hearts, the high suits, score 30 points per trick; diamonds/clubs, the low suits, score 20 per trick; in no trump the first trick scores 40 and each later trick 30; doubling doubles the base score.
map.奖分核算：满贯（小满贯成 6 / 大满贯成 7）、局况奖、超墩奖与加倍/再加倍附: Bonus scoring: a slam (small slam making 6, grand slam making 7), the honours bonus, over-trick bonuses and the doubled/redoubled bonuses are each listed separately.
map.宕墩罚分：未成定约时按加倍状态与有无局况算罚分，局况下方罚更重。: Penalty for a set that fails: when the contract is not made, the penalty is computed from the doubled state and whether honours are held; being declarer in honours scores more penalty.
map.定约分计算：由定约阶数与花色算基础分（♠/♥ 30/墩、♦/♣ 20/墩、无将首: Contract score calculation: the base score follows the contract level and suit (spades/hearts 30 per trick, diamonds/clubs 20 per trick, no trump 40 for the first trick and 30 after), then doubling is added.
map.小满贯（成 6）奖 500（无局况）/750（有局况），大满贯（成 7）奖 10: A small slam (6) scores a 500 bonus (no honours) / 750 (in honours), a grand slam (7) 1000/1500; with redoubling the bonus is scaled up again.
map.局况对计分影响多大？: How much do honours affect the score?
map.有局况时成局/满贯奖分更高、宕墩罚分更重；无局况罚分轻。局况由叫牌轮转表决定。: With honours the contract/slam bonuses are higher and the failed-set penalty is heavier; without honours the penalty is lighter. Honours are determined by the deal rotation table.
